character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
Pixel art character sprite of a Mega-level armored dragon warrior monster inspired by WarGreymon, dynamic side/three-quarter combat stance.

Visual Design:
- Body & Build: Muscular orange reptilian humanoid frame, massive three-toed dinosaur feet with large white talons, red power cables and wrapped conduits along legs, neck, and inner joints.
- Armor & Plating: Polished golden Chrome Digizoid plate armor covering the torso, shoulders, and forearms; segmented silver/steel chestplate, steel spiked greaves on lower legs, and purple waist guard plates.
- Head & Features: Silver horned draconic cyber-helmet with curved horns, sharp snout visor with a small horn, green eyes, and long flowing crimson hair beneath the helm.
- Signature Weaponry & Wings: Massive pair of golden dragon-claw gauntlets (Dramon Killers) with giant razor-sharp tri-blade silver talons mounted on forearms; large curved shield shell halves (Brave Shield) mounted on the back with purple inner lining.

Style Specifications:
- 32-bit crisp RPG pixel art sprite, 64x64 or 128x128 resolution canvas.
- High-contrast metallic gold and chrome reflections, bold black outlines, vibrant comic/anime shading.
- Centered full-body sprite isolated on a clean transparent background.
